answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks with stake-weighted identity: each locks jade collateral through a bridge that binds one key to one on-chain account. Each epoch auditors sample a reef of accounts and demand a timely signed proof; silence or a wrong signature slashes the bond. One honest identity costs one bond, but forging a thousand costs a thousand bonds plus correlated slashing risk, so the attacker pays linearly while payouts stay capped.
